features.label: Universal Fit Elbow Strap
features.text: Fits a forearm circumference of 8 3/4 to 13 in.

features.label: Five Point Viscoelastic Pad
features.text: Contoured pad presses on the forearm muscle to ease tendon pull.

features.label: Tennis and Golfers Elbow
features.text: Place the pad on the outside or inside of the forearm for targeted lateral or medial relief.

features.label: Red Pressure Warning Section
features.text: Visual indicator alerts you if the strap is too tight.

features.label: Elastic Adjustable Arm Strap
features.text: Allows muscles to contract and promotes blood flow.

indications: Epicondylitis lateralis humeri (inflammation of the muscle origin, tennis elbow)
Epicondylitis medialis humeri (inflammation of the muscle origin, golfer's and thrower's elbow)
measurement: Measure around the upper forearm just below the elbow, where the strap sits. Universal size fits 8 3/4 to 13 in. forearm circumference. Choose the Left or Right elbow. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee.
